title.en: S&P considers Nvidia credit downgrade over governance and ‘key man’ risks

summary.en: The credit rating agency may lower Nvidia's credit rating to AA-, the fourth-highest rating.
summary.zh: 该信用评级机构可能会将英伟达的信用评级下调至AA-，即第四高评级。

title.en: Google’s patent for custom AI video feeds paints a bleak picture of entertainment’s future
title.zh: 谷歌的定制AI视频流专利描绘了娱乐业黯淡的未来

summary.zh: 去年，Google 申请了一项名为“My Channel”的系统专利，该系统旨在根据信息……创建包含个性化、由人工智能生成的视频和广告的资讯流。

title.en: OpenAI says heavy ChatGPT users may hit limits sooner as it merges Chat and Work
title.zh: OpenAI表示，随着ChatGPT将聊天和工作功能合并，重度用户可能更快达到使用上限。

summary.en: OpenAI will introduce a single usage meter across ChatGPT as it combines the Chat and Work experiences.
summary.zh: OpenAI 将在整个 ChatGPT 中引入一个统一的使用量仪表，因为它将聊天和工作体验结合在一起。
